operations.contract: Explicit wide_8192_v1 capability; maximum physical PNG 8192x8192; original viewport limits unchanged
Post-screenshot audit only; raster foreground geometry, never a model-visible control
Anonymous A/B badges on existing scalar glyphs; no answer-bearing metadata
Explicit non-diagnostic header perturbation matched to a scalar glyph bounding area; default absent

Explicit source_cards_v1 or source_scopes_v2 captions: preserve original values, spelling, order and occurrence bindings; v2 factors contiguous name prefixes into visible scopes; no default change. Explicit source_reflow_v3 uses unchanged full names/values, compact whitespace and reflow; no prefix factoring. source_scopes_pack_v4 reuses visible prefix factoring with fixed graph padding; independently decode every field; old profiles unchanged.
Explicit disjoint 32px-grid placements within four equal vertical regions; native image exports are exact pixel crops through this renderer; 32px generic header.
Four anonymous fixed QA colors on existing detail-value glyphs; no facts, answers, geometry changes or diagnostic recommendations; defaults absent.

Explicit source_reflow_v3 caption translations, source pixels equal processor pixels, integer dx/dy bounded by16. Complete field blocks, no evidence edits, no default effect; actual DOM/foreground and geometry audit required. Also supports explicit source_scopes_pack_v4 whole local scope blocks.

Explicit independent scalar, metric-point and directed-edge QA; anonymous Q tags only; source geometry, numbers and relation types unchanged. Existing paired qa_badges cannot express five targets and a directed edge. Actual collision/binding audit; no RCA default effect.
Explicit read-only audit of visible captions and processed glyph floor for any existing layout; no image or historical default change.
Explicit exact +16px evidence-raster/support/box translation within existing real margin; header unchanged; no interpolation, crop or default change.

Explicit export registry: uniformly enlarged complete original source cards and a matched processor-resized pixel control. Preserves DOM, bindings, original styles and source evidence. Actual font/line/bounds audit required; no normal dashboard default changes.

Explicit complete-source export, literal bounded crops and compatible comparison annotations. Prepares source tiles offline and composes at most four sources in one 2048-square workspace; preserves the original overview separately. Does not change existing component or operation defaults.

Explicit synthetic independent QA only: exchange complete equal-size source units, or every audited occurrence of two matched entity labels. Reject incomplete relabeling or unequal pixel geometry. Never used for real RCA or real-fault scoring.

Explicit export: delete whole cards or compact surviving original pixels, indices and foreground masks together; no rescaling, new evidence or change to normal renderer defaults. Synthetic whole-card position swap is QA-only.
Synthetic QA only: reciprocal same-unit/same-phase statistic labels, all visible exact copies, unchanged layout and values; fixed original U token indices; never RCA.

New-design fixed_4096_28_v1: final PNG 4096x4096 at scale 1; at most 28 cards across the whole dashboard. All card kinds count, including diagnostic inventory cards. Reject excess cards or later size changes; never select, truncate or rescale evidence. Historical designs without the policy retain their registered behavior.
Explicit source-bound labels, marginal markless and density/QA exports. Preserve ordinary component defaults; actual bound-fact/geometry audit required.

Explicit sample numeral omission, within-card column recovery, sample-only markless, background-fill audit plate, same-scale target isolation and audited entity-bijection QA exports. No normal component/default change. New complete baseline only: require at least 80px sample plots and explicit 4px sample radius, without changing values or card geometry.
